Line: Welcome to our village, traveler.
I need your help with something important.
The situation is dire. We're running out of time.
Have you found what I asked for?
Excellent work! Here's your reward.
I'm afraid I have bad news.
This reminds me of an old legend...
Be careful out there. Danger lurks everywhere.
What brings you to these parts?
I've been expecting you.
The prophecy spoke of your arrival.
Together, we can overcome any obstacle.
I don't trust you yet. Prove yourself.
My gratitude knows no bounds.
This isn't over. Not by a long shot.
I have a feeling we'll meet again.
The ancient texts mention a hero like you.
Time is of the essence!
I've heard tales of your exploits.
Perhaps we can help each other.
